llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及SLM制造医用锆合金及其力学性能，但未覆盖疲劳、多孔结构或骨整合等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper covers LPBF fabrication and static mechanical testing of zirconium, but lacks fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, porous structure design for stiffness matching, and any osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索SLM制备医用锆合金的可行性及其微观结构与力学性能关系
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化技术制备锆样品，结合SEM、EBSD和力学测试进行表征
summary_zh.result: 获得致密锆样品，其微观结构和力学性能与铸造态相当，但延展性较好
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微组织和拉伸/压缩测试验证了工艺参数的影响

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of fabricating biomedical-grade zirconium via selective laser melting and establish the relationship between process parameters, microstructure, and mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Zirconium samples were manufactured by SLM under varying laser parameters, and characterized using SEM, EBSD, and mechanical testing including tensile and compression tests.
summary_en.result: Fully dense zirconium samples were obtained with refined equiaxed grains and mechanical properties comparable to cast material, with improved ductility.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural observation and mechanical testing validated that optimized SLM parameters yield suitable properties for biomedical applications.

papers.title: COMPARISON OF UTILITY SCORES OF HIP ARTHROPLASTY FOR DYSPLASTIC OSTEOARTHRITIS
papers.abstract: Purpose: This study aimed to compare the utility score of dysplastic osteoarthritis of the hip (OA) after different surgical treatments. Methods: In this cross-sectional study, we evaluated the utility scores of 204 patients using the Short Form-6 Dimension. Results: Utility scores of all surgery types were significantly higher than those preoperatively in OA ([Formula: see text]). The utility scores of the unilateral primary total hip arthroplasty (THA) were significantly higher than those of the revision THA. Conclusions: Although THA and osteotomy are effective surgical procedures, lifetime treatment plans should be considered to avoid revision surgery as far as possible.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注髋关节置换术后的临床效用评分，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress/strain, micromotion, or use FEA; it is purely a clinical outcomes study with no implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同手术治疗发育不良性髋关节炎的效用评分。
summary_zh.method: 使用SF-6D问卷评估204名患者效用评分。
summary_zh.result: 全髋关节置换术与截骨术均有效，初次置换优于翻修。
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者报告的临床调查数据。

summary_en.motivation: To compare health utility scores among surgical treatments for dysplastic hip osteoarthritis.
summary_en.method: Cross-sectional study using Short Form-6 Dimension questionnaire to assess utility scores in 204 patients.
summary_en.result: Total hip arthroplasty and osteotomy both improved utility scores, with primary THA superior to revision.
summary_en.validation: Clinical survey-based evaluation without biomechanical testing.
